description: This source file defines a custom UI component called HeroCard, a specialized CardView designed for TV app interfaces. It creates a fixed-size, focusable card with a centered title text, intended to be used within a hero banner row to showcase highlighted content.

classes.name: HeroCard
classes.description: A custom CardView component designed for TV hero banner rows, supporting focus and sizing constraints with an internal method for setting the title.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Updates the text displayed inside the hero card.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels (px) based on device density.
